alt: A detailed diorama depicts an underwater scene with a sandy base, colorful rocks, and green kelp rising to support a clear, ice-like platform where two otters rest.

A detailed diorama depicts a coastal scene with a textured, rocky base covered in sand, featuring a crab, sea urchins, seashells, and a small otter-like creature nestled under the roots of a dark tree trunk surrounded by large green leaves.
A detailed sculpture of a sea otter floating on its back and holding a purple sea urchin, encased in a clear, wavy resin block that simulates water with submerged green kelp.

A detailed miniature diorama features a small, furry creature peeking from behind a blackened tree stump, surrounded by sandy terrain, scattered shells, purple sea urchins, and withered green foliage.
